pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges. Flank patches are significantly larger in spatial area and more amoeboid in shape compared to the smaller, more geometrically regular polygons on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forms a clear negative-space graph. Junction nodes are predominantly characterized by three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the visible mid-section, providing sharp contrast and separation.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal ridge presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. Individual hair tufts create a fine, jagged 1D geometric contour against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A prominent structural discontinuity in the mane is visible at the transition from the neck to the shoulder, caused by the occlusion of a perched avian subject.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark avian-shaped object (oxpecker) is attached to the upper dorsal ridge, creating a localized temporal mark and physical disruption of the mane's silhouette.
